data.long_meaning: In Greek, Ronna derives from the name Rhonnus, meaning 'strong, advisor'. This name has been popular in the Western world due to its biblical associations and spiritual significance. In the New Testament, the name Ronde or Ronda is given to the mother of a child born in Bethlehem when Jesus is presented at the temple. The name Ronna carries the meaning “Strong, advisor” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Ronna usually hope their child will grow to embody strong, advisor and live with faith, good character and purpose.
